content:
There has been some interest in how to best refer to a specific conjecture, for instance as a bibtex entry, but also as a (permalink). I think this is a legitamite questions and we should make that easy.
Generally each conjectures has a unique name wehn fully declared with the namespace, and that name works on the website, for instance RiemannHypothesis.riemannHypothesis has https://google-deepmind.github.io/formal-conjectures/theorem/?name=RiemannHypothesis.riemannHypothesis
Of course to get a really stable pointer to theorem one should use a github commit hash + file and line number.

In order to make it easy to get this right I propose to add bibtex links to each conjecture and some guidance on the README: FC#5172

Comments/reviews welcome!
